title: Tagalog Academy
description: A privacy-first, mastery-oriented Tagalog course for adult learners.
course_outcome: Use practical Tagalog for introductions, preferences, home life, quantities, relationships, and simple market conversations.

weeks.title: Introductions and Family
weeks.summary: Greet, introduce yourself, and describe family.

weeks.title: Colors and Food
weeks.summary: Describe colors and share food preferences.

weeks.title: Objects and Places at Home
weeks.summary: Ask and answer where people and things are.

weeks.title: Numbers, Relationships, and Fruit
weeks.summary: Count, ask prices, buy fruit, and introduce people.

mastery_model.recognize: Understand the phrase when you see or hear it.
mastery_model.apply: Use it in an original sentence or mission.
mastery_model.review: Return after a delay and remember it again.

privacy.storage: Progress is stored locally in the learner's browser.
